Starlink saves lives

[IDÉZETT POSZT, amelyet Elon Musk megosztott. Eredeti szerzője: DogeDesigner (@cb_doge); megjelent: 2026-11-08T14:03:58+00:00; link: https://x.com/cb_doge/status/2119430733525815742; média: videó, 8 másodperc]
Starlink helped save five people stranded in Kazakhstan’s snowy mountains. ♥️

Their SUV broke down about 15 km from the village of Kystau Kurchum. There was no mobile network they could use. Starlink got their call for help through and kept them in touch with rescuers, who used the connection to find them.

Crews drove about 100 km in an all-terrain vehicle and brought all five safely back to the village.

For people stranded far from help, Starlink can be lifesaving technology.
